quotes.text: Don't use encodeURIComponent, folder URLs escape more characters.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The 2024 special-character tag fix used ESCAPE_URL_PATH because encodeURIComponent and folder URL escaping differed. Newer accepted SmartMailboxUtils now records folder.URI when it finds or creates a tag folder, keyed by tag.key. Prefer that known URI in current code. Keep a special-character creation/deletion test so a display label, key and URL cannot produce duplicate folders. The getter may return an unknown URI if no mapping exists; do not promise that it creates a folder.
title: Use the folder system URI rather than a generic string encoder for tag folders
